independent_computation.classification_of_leaf: Self-referential structural counter. '/metadata/fingerprint/leaves' is snapshot-artifact metadata — the count of leaf values in the emitted golden snapshot — not a League of Legends domain quantity (no damage, stat, resistance, cooldown, penetration, or cost). Its value is a function of the snapshot's own emitted shape (how many scenarios are captured and how many leaf fields each scenario's output tree carries), all of which is defined in scripts/golden_snapshot.py, which this oracle is forbidden to read and which is not mirrored anywhere in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md.

independent_computation.conclusion: There is no cached wiki text and no quoted formula in docs/math-foundations.md that determines the number of leaves in the golden snapshot. This leaf is oracle-inert: it encodes no falsifiable claim about the game. It is true by construction of whichever snapshot capture produced it, and can only be checked by self-consistency against the snapshot artifact itself (counting the leaves of scripts/golden_baseline.json), which is outside this oracle's permitted evidence tree.

Confirms the project treats the golden snapshot as a self-comparison gate (captured artifact vs re-captured artifact), i.e. the snapshot is its own reference. A structural counter inside it is therefore self-consistent by construction, never independently true or false.

verdict_basis.strength: WEAK / STRUCTURAL — not an independent domain confirmation.
verdict_basis.reasoning: The three permitted verdicts all presuppose a checkable claim; this leaf carries none. 'both_wrong' would assert positive knowledge of a third, different correct leaf count, which no permitted source supplies — that would be fabrication. 'old_value_correct' would assert that the shape change is a regression, equally unsupported. The remaining verdict is the only one consistent with what the evidence does support: a shape counter is definitionally whatever the current capture emits, so after any legitimate change to the emitted snapshot shape the freshly captured value (54683) is the self-consistent one and the prior value (47612) describes a superseded artifact and is stale by construction.
verdict_basis.explicit_non_claim: This receipt does NOT certify that the shape change itself was intended or correct. It certifies only that 54683 is not contradicted by, and 47612 is not supported by, any cached wiki text or quoted formula. The parent must not read this leaf as evidence that the change under test is numerically right.

residual_risk_and_falsification_test.risk: A +7071 (+14.85%) jump in leaf count is a shape change, not a value change. If the change under test was a pure refactor or a pure numeric fix, the leaf count should have been INVARIANT, and a moved counter would then be the signal of an unintended shape change (added/renamed output fields, added scenarios, or a duplicated subtree). This oracle cannot distinguish those cases from the permitted evidence tree.
residual_risk_and_falsification_test.test_the_parent_can_run: Count the leaf values of the captured baseline (scripts/golden_baseline.json) and confirm it equals the metadata value 54683 — self-consistency. Then confirm the +7071 delta is fully accounted for by intentionally added shape: (added_scenarios x leaves_per_scenario) + (added_fields x scenarios). If any part of the 7071 is unexplained, the shape change is unintended regardless of this verdict.
residual_risk_and_falsification_test.runbook_recommendation: Flag '/metadata/fingerprint/leaves' as an ORACLE-INERT leaf class in future R-18/R-19 windows. Self-referential artifact metadata cannot be adjudicated by an independent oracle restricted to data/ + docs/math-foundations.md, and routing it to one produces a verdict with no domain content. Such leaves belong to a shape-diff gate (delta must be itemized against intended added shape), not to the oracle.
